description: This Java class 'Scenario4MultipleSubjects16' implements the 'Scenario4MultipleSubjects' interface to define a specific access control scenario setup for testing purposes within a security or permission evaluation framework. It initializes a ScenarioSetup object with specific subject permissions and provides access to this setup and a policy algorithm application function.

classes.name: Scenario4MultipleSubjects16
classes.description: A test scenario class configuring permission checks for multiple subjects along a resource hierarchy in testing environments.

methods.name: Scenario4MultipleSubjects16
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the scenario setup with specific permission assertions and context.
